title: Adopt only matching issue content and repair links explicitly
when: Issue creation or discovery of a wrong item or task link
need: Automatic adoption compares the complete outgoing title and body, ignoring whitespace only. Explicit link repair can unlink or choose an issue in the project's bound repository without changing either issue.
surface: GitHub sync reference and registered link command help
gap: Candidate source and regression tests require deployed proof before verified-live status.
review: Source implementation uses the compact body actually sent by creation; old task title fallback is removed.
